nodes.name: buzzer.ino
nodes.summary: Bring-up test sketch for the passive buzzer. Includes config.h, defaults BUZZER_PIN to 3 if undefined, and plays an ascending C-major melody (262-523 Hz) in a loop using tone()/noTone() to verify the buzzer pin and PWM tone output. Logs 'Buzzer test start' at 115200 baud.

nodes.name: led.ino
nodes.summary: Bring-up test sketch that blinks the on-board/external LED to verify GPIO output and timing. Defaults LED_PIN to 8 if undefined (does not include config.h), toggles HIGH/LOW with 500 ms delays. Logs 'LED test start' at 115200 baud.

nodes.name: mpu.ino
nodes.summary: Bring-up test sketch for the MPU6050 accel/gyro over I2C using Adafruit_MPU6050. Includes config.h, defaults SDA_PIN=6/SCL_PIN=7, initializes I2C and the sensor (halts on failure), configures 8G accel range, 500 deg/s gyro range, 21 Hz bandwidth, then streams 'AccelX:..,AccelY:..,AccelZ:.., GyroX:..,GyroY:..,GyroZ:..' lines over serial every 100 ms. This serial format is consumed by visualize.html.

nodes.name: oled.ino
nodes.summary: Bring-up test sketch for the 128x64 SSD1306 OLED over I2C using Adafruit_SSD1306 / Adafruit_GFX. Includes config.h, defaults SDA_PIN=6/SCL_PIN=7, initializes the display at address 0x3C (halts on allocation failure), and draws 'OLED test OK'. Empty loop.

nodes.name: wifi.ino
nodes.summary: Bring-up test sketch that verifies WiFi on the ESP32-C3. Includes <WiFi.h>, sets station mode, disconnects, then repeatedly scans for networks and prints the count over serial every 5 s. No external config include.

nodes.name: visualize.html
nodes.summary: Standalone single-page 'MPU6050 Live Visualizer'. Uses the Web Serial API (navigator.serial.requestPort) to connect to the board, reads the serial stream with a TextDecoder, parses the 'AccelX:..,AccelY:..' lines emitted by mpu.ino, and plots accel/gyro values live on two <canvas> charts. A Connect button drives the session.
